# SitePoint

> SitePoint is a comprehensive web development learning platform covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Node.js, and modern development practices including AI integration and deployment.

SitePoint provides tutorials, guides, and articles for web developers at all levels, with expertise spanning frontend technologies, backend frameworks, testing methodologies, DevOps practices, and emerging AI/LLM integration patterns. The site features contributions from industry experts and covers both foundational web development concepts and cutting-edge technologies.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript & Node.js
- CSS & Frontend Development
- Web Development Tutorials
- Backend Testing
- AI & LLM Integration
- Generative UI
- Kubernetes & DevOps
- Local LLM Deployment
- Privacy & Security
- Web Development Trends
- Jest Testing Framework
- LangChain
- Responsive Design

## Core Learning Resources

- [SitePoint — Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Ruby & Responsive Design](https://www.sitepoint.com): SitePoint homepage offering web development tutorials in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and responsive design
- [SitePoint Blog — The Best Web Development & Design Blog](https://www.sitepoint.com/blog): SitePoint blog featuring web development articles on JavaScript, CSS, PHP, UX and design trends
